messages:
maya: quick sync — we need a concrete proposal for streaming delivery semantics that covers resume behavior, finish reasons, and tool-calling interplay. customers are asking for clarity so they can design SDKs.

jon: high level questions to resolve: SSE vs WS as primary transport? do we require sequence numbers? how do we encode deltas (plain text vs structured ops)?

liam: my take: pick one canonical wire contract that's simple for mobile/web SDKs. prefer SSE for hosted API (HTTP friendly) but offer WebSocket for low-latency multiplexing. both should share the same JSON payload shape.

maya: +1 on single JSON shape. can you sketch minimal fields? i want resume support so clients can reconnect after network blips without redoing work.

liam: propose payload: `{"seq": 42, "type": "delta", "delta": {"text":"hello","tokens":2}, "cursor":"abc123"}` then special `type: finish` with `finish_reason`. resume uses last acked `seq` or `cursor`.

jon: we should be explicit about finish_reason enum. customers expect deterministic values. suggest: `stop`, `length`, `user`, `error`, `function_call`, `timeout`. Add `partial`?

sophia: prefer `partial` avoided — it muddies contract. `stop` (llm emitted stop), `length` (truncated by limit), `user` (client invoked stop), `function_call` (function call completed), `error` (internal) and `timeout` (SLO). that's clear.

maya: what about streaming function calling? example: model sends incremental `function_call` deltas (name, args chunked). how do we surface that vs text deltas?

liam: include `delta.type` variants: `text`, `function_call`, `structured`. function_call payload: `{"name": "foo", "args_chunk": "{...}"}` and we keep `seq` ordering so client can assemble. final finish will have `"finish_reason": "function_call"` and an optional `function_return` blob when done.

jon: backpressure and client acking — do we require client acks? I think we shouldn't, but we should support optional client ACK for resume safety (server keeps short-lived resume windows, e.g., 30s).

sophia: mobile proxies drop idle SSE frequently. we need reconnect guidance: Exponential backoff + resume token if within 30s else fallback to non-stream full response. Document examples in SDKs.

maya: launch criteria draft: 1) canonical JSON schema published + examples; 2) SDKs (node, python, ios) implement resume and assemble function_call; 3) p95 end-to-end first-token latency for streaming <= 300ms for 64-token bursts; 4) resume success rate >= 99% under flaky networks in tests.

liam: + add: fallbacks: if resume fails, surface `finish_reason: error` with `error.code: resume_failed` and a `restart_recommendation` in payload.

jon: also need clear guidance for logs/observability: record last emitted `seq`, client resume attempts, and successful assembly of function args. tie to Redwood Console metrics.

maya: sounds good. can we get an API doc PR by EOD tomorrow? liam, jon — can you pair on the canonical schema + example SSE/WS snippets? sophia will draft SDK guidance and tests. i'll collect and turn into a launch checklist.

deploy-bot: scheduled reminder set for 2026-03-19 09:00 UTC — "streaming delivery contract PR due" :bell:

liam: will do, pairing now. starting sketch in `docs/streaming/delivery_contract.md` and will link back here when ready.

jon: i'll add CI tests that simulate 5% packet loss and verify resume window behavior.

maya: thanks team — keep replies short, i'll synthesize after PRs land. :thumbsup:
